name: mcp-jobber
description: Read clients, quotes, invoices, and jobs from Jobber, run a global search, and make a couple of safe writes (client tags, quote notes), via the Jobber GraphQL API.
long_description: Model Context Protocol server wrapping the Jobber GraphQL API (api.getjobber.com/api/graphql), built with FastMCP. Nine jobber_* tools. OAuth 2 authorization-code auth with transparent refresh, plus a bearer-token fallback. Client-side throttling sized to Jobber's 2500 requests / 5 minutes. See https://github.com/MMavec/mcp-jobber for full docs; run `mcp-jobber-introspect` to confirm schema-specific field/enum names for your Jobber API version.

client_id.title: Jobber OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: From your app in the Jobber Developer Center. Leave blank if using a bearer token.

client_secret.title: Jobber OAuth Client Secret
client_secret.description: From your app in the Jobber Developer Center.

bearer_token.title: Jobber bearer access token (fallback)
bearer_token.description: Optional. A bearer access token to use as-is with no auto-refresh (Jobber issues no long-lived personal tokens, so this is for quick local use).

graphql_version.title: Jobber GraphQL API version
graphql_version.description: Sent as X-JOBBER-GRAPHQL-VERSION. Must be an active version date from Jobber's changelog.

tools.name: jobber_list_clients
tools.description: List clients, optionally filtered by tag labels (limit, offset, tags).

tools.name: jobber_get_client
tools.description: Fetch a single client by Jobber ID (emails, phones, tags, timestamps).

tools.name: jobber_update_client_tags
tools.description: Write: replace a client's tag list with the provided labels.

tools.name: jobber_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes filtered by status, client, and/or updatedAfter.

tools.name: jobber_get_quote
tools.description: Fetch a quote with line items and notes.

tools.name: jobber_create_note_on_quote
tools.description: Write: attach a note to a quote.

tools.name: jobber_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices filtered by client, paid status, and issued-date range.

tools.name: jobber_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs filtered by status and/or completion date.

tools.name: jobber_search
tools.description: Global search across clients, jobs, quotes, and invoices (results partitioned by type).
